text:
maria-se: Kicking off Medius POC timeline sync — I put a living doc here: https://redwood.workspaces/medius-poc (please comment). Key asks: milestones, owners, infra deps, and a proposed dry-run/cutover window. Can folks reply with owners and any blockers?

jonathan-sales: Customer success criteria: 1) SSO + SCIM 2) <100ms median tail for inference (demo load) 3) logs retained 30d. They'll want a go/no-go 48h before cutover. Who owns comms to Medius?

azeem-eng: I'll own infra + network. Immediate deps: VPC peering, certs for internal API, and a model-variant pin (we should avoid latest-bleeding). Need Medius network contact and firewall rules. Also: do we want Dedicated or Private for this trial?

rita-pe: I'll take API contract + example payloads. Minimal deliverables: webhook ingestion, health endpoint, auth header + sample tokens, and an errors schema. Quick checklist:
```
- /health (200)
- POST /infer { input: string }
- X-Redwood-Auth: token
- stream vs non-stream behaviour documented
```
We need sample traffic profiles to size batching configs.

andrew-se: I'll own cutover window + dry-run. Propose a dry-run week: 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-06 with a final cutover on 2025-06-10. Needs validation script and smoke tests.

maria-se: Owners so far: @azeem-eng infra/network, @rita-pe api contract, @andrew-se cutover, @jonathan-sales customer comms. I'll add these to the doc. Please confirm if you can hit the dry-run dates.

lisa-cs: Noting support/ops expectations: 24/7 on-call for cutover day? We'll need log forwarding + access to per-request traces for first 72h. Also confirm retention: 30d ok. @maria-se who triages escalations?

deploy-bot: [automated] Reserved dedicated capacity: medium-pool-3 scheduled 2025-06-08T04:00:00Z -> 2025-06-15T04:00:00Z. Allocation ID: alloc-9f2b.

jonathan-sales: Add sam from Medius networking to this thread — he said he'll coordinate peering windows.

sam-net: Hi all — sam@medius here. I can do peering Thu 2025-06-05 09:00-11:00 PST. Required firewall rules: outbound 443 to 10.12.0.0/22 and allow inbound 1024-65535 for ephemeral. I'll send our CIDRs.

azeem-eng: Sounds good. I'll prep a minimal terraform snippet for peering and post to the doc. Also will pin model to redwood/infer-v2-quant to keep latency predictable.

maria-se: Great — thank you. Action items I'll capture: 1) Azeem: terraform + cert plan 2) Rita: API contract + sample traffic 3) Andrew: dry-run runbook + smoke tests 4) Jonathan: customer comms cadence 5) Sam: CIDRs + peering window. Please add any timing constraints in the doc by EOD. :thumbsup:

andrew-se: Will draft smoke tests tomorrow and post a checklist.

lisa-cs: I'll attach on-call rotation and escalation contact to the doc by EOD.

maria-se: Closing loop — I'll update the timeline and ping again once the runbook is wired. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
